data.one_liner: A Redux middleware that allows dispatching async functions as actions.
data.what_it_does: Provides thunkMiddleware to intercept and execute ThunkActions in a Redux store. Enables performing asynchronous work and dispatching subsequent actions.
use_when: You are using Redux.dart and need to handle asynchronous operations.
You want to dispatch functions that take the Store as an argument.
avoid_when: You are not using the Redux state management pattern.
You prefer modern state management alternatives like Riverpod or Bloc.
strengths: Enables asynchronous work in Redux architectures.
Simple API with a single thunkMiddleware.
weaknesses: No advanced side-effect handling features beyond basic functions.
data.setup_notes: Add thunkMiddleware to your Redux Store middleware list.

alternatives.name: bloc
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a predictable state management solution with built-in stream and async support without Redux boilerplate.

alternatives.name: riverpod
alternatives.why_pick_it: A robust, modern state management library supporting async operations natively.
